entities.name: Samite
entities.description: A very large sect of devout healers, clerics and alchemists who heal any sentient being in need on Dominaria, Ulgrotha and Mercadia.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the Samite tradition has lasted thousands of years.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: Plane where Orim brought the Samite order.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: Most famous Samite cleric, of the Weatherlight crew; brought the order to Mercadia.

entities.name: Reyhan
entities.description: Samite alchemist on Ulgrotha during Homelands.

entities.name: Oriss
entities.description: Orim's daughter, a Samite Guardian on Mercadia.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship whose crew Orim belonged to.

entities.name: Time Spiral crisis
entities.description: Crisis after which the Samite order continued.

entities.name: Apocalypse Chime
entities.description: Item whose ringing brought apocalypse to Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Ancients
entities.description: Side in a war with the Tolgath on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Tolgath
entities.description: Side in a war with the Ancients on Ulgrotha.

events.summary: Orim returns to Mercadia with Karn's assistance after the Phyrexian Invasion and brings the Samite order there.
events.quote: Orim brought the Samite order to the plane of Mercadia

events.summary: The Samite presence on Ulgrotha survives the apocalypse.
events.quote: The Samite presence on the plane survived through the apocalypse and continues to the present day.

relations.quote: Perhaps the most famous of all Samite clerics was Orim
Her daughter Oriss was a Samite Guardian
The Samite alchemist Reyhan was among their number during the time of Homelands .
